text:
drew: Heads-up — GreenHarbor wants a 4-week on‑prem POC in a sealed packaging plant. No outbound network allowed, only physical media transfers (USB/courier). They will provide a Nitrokey HSM 2 and want customer-held signing keys. Deliverables: feasibility, operator signing runbook, offline activation flow, chain-of-custody steps, and POC quote (license + eng days + courier).
harper: Got it. Quick clarifying q: do they expect Redwood Private (control plane customer-hosted) or a Dedicated node image we ship? Also confirm kernel module restrictions and whether an operator workstation is available inside the perimeter.
drew: Prefer Private but open to Dedicated if we can guarantee zero egress. Kernel locked — no new kernel modules. They do provide an operator box inside the plant for signing and acceptance.
lee: Runtime notes: Nitrokey exposes PKCS#11 userland API — good fit. No kernel module required. We can implement a detached signature verification during the installer that loads the Nitrokey PKCS#11 module.
mika: Security checklist to prep for the SQ: telemetry must be off by default and we must provide a signed attestation post‑POC; SBOM and commit hashes required; local audit logs only, export via signed tar on request; FIPS not required for now but they may ask later.
drew: They explicitly asked about offline license renewal cadence — quarterly windows only; emergency hotfixes via courier acceptable with operator signoff.
harper: Two signing patterns we should propose: 1) Customer-sign (preferred): we provide a sig‑request + verification hook; operator signs with Nitrokey inside plant. 2) Redwood-signed manifest + customer verification. Pattern 1 gives them key custody.
lee: Example operator flow (concept):
```
# on CI: produce bundle + manifest
rdwctl bundle create --model rdw-quant-7b --out rdw-bundle.tar.gz --manifest manifest.json
# create detached sig-request for operator
rdwctl sig-request --manifest manifest.json > sigreq.bin
# operator signs inside air-gapped workstation with nitrokey-pkcs11
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libnitrokey-pkcs11.so -s -y privkey -i sigreq.bin -o sig.bin
# installer verify before apply
rdwctl verify --manifest manifest.json --sig sig.bin --pkcs11-module /usr/lib/libnitrokey-pkcs11.so
```
mika: Add chain-of-custody to manifest: fields like seal_id, courier_receipt (name/timestamp), operator_signoff (name/timestamp). We'll include a tamper_evidence boolean.
drew: Acceptance criteria they asked for: offline upgrade apply < 1 hour for POC, zero outbound telemetry, and model perf validated against a 2000-token test set. Avoid hard latency numbers until lab run.
harper: Bundle sizing: recommend quantized artifacts for courier efficiency. Typical incremental delta ~150MB-1.5GB; full float bundle up to 10-18GB if unquantized.
lee: Offline license options supported: time-limited activation token signed by customer HSM, or offline license file signed by Redwood and countersigned by customer operator. Token renewal via physical media only.
ops-bot: Created ticket RDW-9203: "GreenHarbor sealed-plant POC — Nitrokey signing & offline activation" assigned to @lee. https://redwood.example/tickets/RDW-9203
drew: Pricing sketch: Private deployment license + one-time onboarding eng (3-6 eng days) + per-shipment courier. Mika/Harper: can you add optional FIPS support and verification line items to the SOW?
mika: I'll draft the SQ answers (telemetry, SBOM, logs, incident contacts) and include the attestation template. Please DM me their questionnaire PDF.
harper: I'll build a short SOW skeleton and include chain-of-custody, on-site eng days, and courier cost bands. Dropping it in RDW-9203 by EOD.
lee: Engineering action items: spin up Nitrokey in lab, validate pkcs11 signing/verify, produce a sample manifest + sigreq and a minimal installer that verifies PKCS#11 signatures. I'll post lab notes to RDW-9203.
drew: I'll schedule a 30m presales + eng + security call with GreenHarbor for tomorrow 10am PT. Lee/Mika/Harper bring runbook, sample manifest, and SQ draft.
harper: One operational note — operator training: we should include a 2-hr operator run-through during POC (how to sign, verify seals, and apply bundle). Add to SOW as one day on-site.
mika: Also include a documented emergency hotfix flow: pre-approval, courier delivery, operator verification, install checklist, and signed post-install attestation. Target manual apply <45m for hotfix if delta <500MB.
drew: Thanks team. I'll confirm with the customer and attach the invite + draft SOW. :white_check_mark:
